content.comment_body: I am using a [product_name] CPU with two [product_name] I/O modules. The inputs are activating at voltage levels below 100V, even though triggering should occur only at 115V. Can anyone assist? Thank you
Unfortunately, this is not possible. Please find the technical data attached. The detection limits for low and high signals are predetermined and cannot be changed.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have noted that the digital inputs of [product_name] hardware activate at voltages lower than specified, resulting in unintended switching events. The product's operation does not meet user expectations for input voltage thresholds, and reference to technical data confirms that these thresholds are fixed and cannot be modified.
